newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuelan bolivar end firmer at 476.50/477.50.
newsitem.headline: Venezuelan bolivar end firmer at 476.50/477.50.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed slightly firmer at 476.50/477.50 per dollar Friday compared to 477.75/477.75 per dollar Thursday, after currency sales rose sharply in the afternoon following a steep rise in overnight bank rates, traders said.
Quiet trading in the morning turned busy in the afternoon as overnight bank lending rates rose as high as 50 percent traders said.
"There was a lot of banks selling dollars to maintain their liquidity in bolivars" one trader said.
Traders said the exchange rate was expected to be remain broadly stable next week barring any major announcements on economic policy.
